text: If they cannot bear with me, let them kill me. For better were it to die, than so to live as they would have thee. Make it not any longer a matter of dispute or discourse, what are the signs and proprieties of a good man, but really and actually to be such. Ever to represent unto thyself; and to set before thee, both the general age and time of the world, and the whole substance of it. And how all things particular in respect of these are for their substance, as one of the least seeds that is: and for their duration, as the turning of the pestle in the mortar once about.
